mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_state ( rule_id, status, last_checked_at, last_fired_at, last_notification_enqueued_at, last_notified_at, next_check_at ) SELECT #{ruleId}, #{status}, #{lastCheckedAt}, #{lastFiredAt}, #{lastNotificationEnqueuedAt}, #{lastNotifiedAt}, #{nextCheckAt} FROM alarm_rule_v2 WHERE id = #{ruleId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = #{status}, last_checked_at = #{lastCheckedAt}, last_fired_at = #{lastFiredAt}, last_notification_enqueued_at = #{lastNotificationEnqueuedAt}, next_check_at = #{nextCheckAt}
